name: load_id
description: Sortable identifier for one physical load attempt. Generated at load start from the UTC load timestamp plus a short cryptographically random suffix, so later load attempts sort after earlier ones.

name: source_object
description: GCS object path containing the source SCHEDULE publication.

name: source_generation
description: GCS generation identifying the exact physical version of the source object.

name: publication_sequence
description: Network Rail publication sequence number used to identify and order SCHEDULE publications.

name: extract_type
description: SCHEDULE extract type from the publication metadata; expected values are 'full' or 'update'.

name: transaction_type
description: Source transaction type for the association record; expected values are 'Create' or 'Delete'. Full extracts are expected to contain only 'Create' records.

name: CIF_stp_indicator
description: Short-term planning indicator for the association: `C` cancellation, `N` new STP association, `O` overlay, or `P` permanent.

name: assoc_start_date
description: First date on which the association applies. Present on both 'Create' and 'Delete' records.

name: assoc_train_uid
description: UID of the associated scheduled service. In this dataset, 'train' refers to a scheduled service rather than a physical rolling-stock asset.

name: base_location_suffix
description: Suffix which, together with location, identifies the relevant event on the main/base schedule when the TIPLOC occurs more than once. Present in both 'Create' and 'Delete' shapes but commonly null.

name: diagram_type
description: Association diagram type. The published SCHEDULE feed uses the constant value `T`.

name: location
description: TIPLOC code of the location at which the association applies.

name: main_train_uid
description: UID of the main/base scheduled service in the association. In this dataset, 'train' refers to a scheduled service rather than a physical rolling-stock asset.

name: assoc_days
description: Seven-character Monday-to-Sunday running-day mask for the association, where `1` means the association applies on that day. Present on 'Create' records and omitted on 'Delete' records.

name: assoc_end_date
description: Last date on which the association applies. Present on 'Create' records and omitted on 'Delete' records.

name: assoc_location_suffix
description: Suffix which, together with location, identifies the relevant event on the associated schedule when the TIPLOC occurs more than once. Present on 'Create' records, omitted on 'Delete' records, and commonly null.

name: category
description: Association category code, including values such as `JJ`, `VV` and `NP`. Present on 'Create' records and omitted on 'Delete' records.

name: date_indicator
description: Date relationship between the associated schedules, including `S` same day, `N` next day and `P` previous day. Present on 'Create' records and omitted on 'Delete' records.
